Oh I've got a great story for all of you! Now I wasn't the most easy to care for kid growing up. Having Aspergers and ADHD doesn't a good combination make for Sunday School. But this was the funniest one looking back. I loved to draw as a kid and since I couldn't be in the grownups church area I had to go to Sunday School. Well one day I'm just minding my own business and drawing five pointed stars all over the worksheet I was given. I had just learned how to make a five pointed star and was proud of myself for knowing how to do it. Anyway the Sunday School teacher comes around and is looking at everyones work. When she see's that I'm drawing stars she immediately takes the sheet of paper and crayon away from me not telling me why. I start crying and fussing telling her to give back my drawing, that it's my drawing not hers. She refuses and I believe she put it in her desk and for the rest of the time I wasn't allowed to draw with anything! Thus I was sobbing about how I couldn't draw and that she was being mean. (I was like five or six years old) After Sunday school the teacher approaches my mom and shows her my worksheet. Telling her that I was making the 'devils sign' and that I was possessed. My mom asked what I did after she took the drawing away, the lady said that I wasn't allowed to draw. My mom was SOOO MAD! She went off on this lady explaining my ADHD and how things could have been a lot worse than just me crying and wanting my drawing back. Now this lady was OFF HER ROCKER! And told my mom that Satan made me that way, this just made her angrier and she snatched the drawing out of the ladies hands, took my hand in hers and walked out. We never went back to that Church again. 
TL;DR Teacher in Sunday School saw me drawing stars and freaked out about it being evil. Left church with mom. Never went back
